newsitem.title: CANADA: Travel to and from Canada falls in May.
newsitem.headline: Travel to and from Canada falls in May.

text.p: Travel to and from Canada fell in May compared with a month earlier, Statistics Canada said on Wednesday.
Canadian overnight trips to the United States fell 1.9 percent, seasonally adjusted, to 1.27 million trips from 1.29 million trips in April, StatsCan said.
The number of trips Canadians took to other countries fell 6.4 percent to 318,000 from 340,000 in April, the agency said.

For visitors to Canada, visits from the United States dropped 1.9 percent in May to 1.11 million trips from 1.13 million in April. Visits from other countries dropped 6.4 percent to 359,000 trips from 383,000 in April.
